arguments.sql: SELECT substr(date, 1, 10) AS day, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY day ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, day ASC LIMIT 1
arguments.explanation: This finds the calendar day with the most transactions and gives its transaction count.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, an error or a negative amount.
A day is the date part of the transaction timestamp as stored. No time zone conversion is applied.
If two days tie, the earlier one is returned.
